caseName: Mid-America Telephone Co. v. Public Utilities Commission
caseNameFull: Mid-America Telephone Co. v. Public Utilities Commission of Ohio
attorneys: Mark McElroy, Attorney General of Ohio, Herbert T. Maher and Andrew R. Sarisky, Assistant Attorneys General, and E. N. Strand for respondents.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. The alternative motion to dispense with printing the petition for certiorari granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Ohio denied.
